cacheRule: Every listed call charges even if served from an immutable cache or existing session. Repeated sort.go blob is one distinct byte charge but two operation calls; repeated policy OID is one distinct byte charge and one operation per request. A memo of a multi-step canonical derivation must preserve all reference logical charges, not collapse them to one. Stable currently uses no request memo.
ordering: Evidence and mapped mechanical work follow input list order; simulation follows canonical patch section order; differing subtrees breadth-first by depth, parents in prior level order, union child names unsigned byte lexicographic, old then new when both trees. Root-pair is its own single batch. Every level batch is one charge regardless of records; empty level/proof batch adds none. Lookup is one batch regardless of path depth and includes commit/root/intermediate authentication.
limits: The 336-evidence complete map uses 1023 reservations and is accepted. The 337-evidence map has an attempted trace of 1025 reservations: call 1024 is admitted for sorted drift item 335, call 1025 refuses before spawn for sorted drift item 336, and no later row exists. Repeated identical OID or path does not erase reservations. This is a real map-level reference, not injected precharges.
outerExpiryCommitment: OQ-04 C cases per-op-timeout-returned-then-outer-expiry-in-teardown and per-op-timeout-unreturned-then-outer-expiry-in-teardown charge the same logical calls as canonical-per-op-timeout.
